text: Haste makes waste.

orig: Al buon vino non bisogna frasca.

orig: Chi dorme non piglia pesci.

orig: Fortuna i forti aiuta, e i timidi rifiuta.

text: In wine, truth.

text: Although it is small, it is given with love.
orig: E iti noa ana, nā te aroha

text: A little is better than none.
orig: He pai ake te iti i te kore

text: What is the most important thing in the world? It is people, people, people.
orig: He aha te mea nui o te ao? He tangata, he tangata, he tangata

text: Tell me who you walk with and I'll tell you who you are.
orig: Niway piwanmi purinki, ñoqa nisqayki pin kanki

text: A thief thinks everyone else is a thief.
orig: Tukuy suwan, llapanmi suwa nin

text: When the villages work together, we turn the world around.
orig: Llaqtakunaq atipayninwan, teqsimuyuta kuyuchisunchis

text: Do not lie, do not steal, do not be lazy.
orig: Ama llulla, ama suwa, ama qhilla

text: It is better to die standing than to live on your knees.
orig: Wañuymi aswan allin, qonqorchaki kausaytaqa
